# Read tools for agents: get_node_output and get_artifacts

## What to build

Two more graph-manager MCP tools (KAN-91 #10, #11) for agents in graph-manager terminals, in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/`, registered in `TOOLS` (`tools/index.ts`):

- `get_node_output { runId, node, lines? }`: what one node of a run produced: for a task id its status, attempts and error (from `state.json` and graph-manager's cached view of the run page), then the tail of its agent log under `<runDir>/logs/`. Review-pipeline nodes (`@reviewer`, `@tester`, other reviewers `@<id>`, `@fixer`, `@gate-fixer`, `@gate`, `@merge`) work the same way.
- `get_artifacts { runId }`: the files the run changed (path, status, +/-) from git, between the run's starting commit and its result branch, plus the run's own report files under its run folder.

The dependency task already delivered `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/run-helpers.ts` with: `NOT_IN_WORKSPACE`, `isToolResult(v)`, `requireWorkspace(tc): Workspace | ToolResult` (error text `this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace`), `runDirOrError(ws, runId): Promise<string | ToolResult>` (error `unknown run <id>` for an invalid id or a missing folder), `readTailLines(file, lines): Promise<string | undefined>`, `workspaceRel(ws, p)`, `cell(s)`, `table(head, rows)`, `fenced(text)`. And `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/tool-test-helpers.ts` with `toolApp(overrides?)` (an app with internal token `t0ken`, a real git workspace `wsDir` = `<workspacesDir>/github/octo/hello` on branch `main` with one empty commit, `terminalId` in it, `rootTerminalId` outside it, `call(name, input, { cwd?, terminalId? })`, `cleanup()`) and `writeRun(wsDir, runId, overrides?)` (writes a valid `state.json`; default tasks `1` merged, `2` failed with 2 attempts, status `failed`, `startingCommit` `"0".repeat(40)`, `integrationBranch` `graph/<runId>`). Read both files first. It also registered `list_runs`, `get_run_log`, `list_graphs` in `tools/index.ts`.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/run-helpers.ts`, `tool-test-helpers.ts`, `get-run-log.ts` (+ test) — the helpers and the closest existing tool and test to copy.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/runs.ts` — `runDetail(ws, runId, dataDir?)` (lines 485-515: summary, state, graph, cached `view`, `tasks: TaskRow[]` with `status`/`attempts`/`error`; settles in-flight statuses to `interrupted` once the run ended), `TaskRow` (74-85), private `git()` (382-395) and `PATHSPEC` (379) to mirror, `sumNumstat` (398-408), `landedChanges` (433-442).
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/viewcache.ts` (lines 14-55) — `CachedView`: `nodes`, `agents` (keys `reviewer`, `tester`, `fixer`, `gateFixer`, and other reviewers by id), `gate`, `merge`, `summary.abort`, `summary.merge.reason`; each `CachedNode` has `status`, `attempt`, `attempts`, `error`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/state/state.ts` (lines 15-24, 65-90) — `TaskState` (`status`, `attempts`, `branch`, `mergeCommit`, `baseSha`) and `RunState` (`startingCommit`, `integrationBranch` = `graph/<runId>`, `targetBranch`, `tasksDir`, `status`).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/ui/store.ts` (lines 347-358) — `logFileName(label) = label.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "-") + ".log"` and `writeAgentLogs`, which APPENDS every agent output to `<runDir>/logs/<logFileName(label)>` (`runner/run.ts:306-308`). All attempts of the same label go to the same file.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/nodes.ts` (all) — pipeline node ids: `@gate`, `@merge`, `@reviewer`, `@tester`, `@fixer`, `@gate-fixer`; other reviewers are `@<id>`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/review/reviewers.ts` (lines 136-139, 179-196) — `BUILTIN_REVIEWERS` (`code`, `tester`), `readRunReviewers` (reads `<runDir>/reviewers.json`, `RUN_REVIEWERS_FILE`), `reviewerNode(id)`: `code` → `@reviewer`, else `@<id>`. `BUILTIN_REVIEWERS`, `RUN_REVIEWERS_FILE` and `parseReviewers(raw, where)` are exported from `graph-execution/api`; `logFileName` and `reviewerNode` are NOT (re-implement the one-liners locally with a comment naming the engine source).
- `packages/graph-execution/src/agents/summarizer.ts` (lines 10-16, 33, 122) — failure summaries are written to `<runDir>/summaries/<sanitize(nodeId)>-<epochMs>.json` with `{ cause, verdict, why }`; `sanitize = id.replace(/[^\w.-]+/g, "-").replace(/^-+/, "")`.
- `packages/graph-execution/src/runner/run.ts` (lines 455-475, 655-680) — the integration branch `graph/<runId>` holds every merged task; after `applied`/`done` it is kept ("the result is on graph/<id>"), and `applied` means it was squash-applied to `targetBranch` in the workspace checkout as uncommitted changes.
- `docs/prd/agent-supervisor.md` — table rows `get_node_output`, `get_artifacts`.

## Where the logs are (verified in the engine; labels go through `logFileName`)

| node | log files in `<runDir>/logs/` | status source in the cached view |
| --- | --- | --- |
| task `<id>` | `<id>.log` (agent, all attempts and validation fix rounds appended); `<id>-validate-<round>.log` (failed validation output); `task-<id>-merge-resolver.log` (merge conflicts) | `view.nodes[id]` / `state.tasks[id]` / `detail.tasks` row |
| `@reviewer` (reviewer id `code`) | `code-r<round>.log` | `view.agents.reviewer` |
| `@tester` | `tester-r<round>.log` | `view.agents.tester` |
| `@<id>` (custom reviewer) | `<id>-r<round>.log` | `view.agents[<id>]` |
| `@fixer` | `fix-r<pass>.log`, `fix-r<pass>-v<round>.log` (pass ≥ 1) | `view.agents.fixer` |
| `@gate-fixer` | `fix-r0-v<round>.log` | `view.agents.gateFixer` |
| `@gate` | `review-validate.log`, `review-validate-<round>.log` (validation output, no agent) | `view.gate` |
| `@merge` | none (show `view.summary.merge.reason` when set) | `view.merge` |

"The latest attempt when there are several" = among the node's matching files, tail the main agent log (`<id>.log` for a task) or, for pipeline nodes, the newest matching file by mtime (ties: the larger round number). List the node's other log files by name (workspace-relative) under the tail.

## Patterns to follow

**Tool start** (helpers from run-helpers.ts):
```ts
const ws = requireWorkspace(tc);
if (isToolResult(ws)) return ws;
const runDir = await runDirOrError(ws, i.runId);
if (typeof runDir !== "string") return runDir;
const detail = await runDetail(ws, i.runId, tc.ctx.config.dataDir);
```

**git in the workspace** (copy `runs.ts:382-395`):
```ts
const res = await execa("git", args, { cwd: ws.path, env: { ...process.env, GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0" }, reject: false, stdin: "ignore", timeout: 10_000 });
return res.exitCode === 0 ? String(res.stdout ?? "") : undefined;
```
Exclude graph-execution's own folder with the pathspec `["--", ".", ":(exclude).graph-execution"]` (`RUNS_DIR` from `graph-execution/api`).

**Test pattern**: copy `tools/get-run-log.test.ts` (uses `toolApp()` and `writeRun()`); git commits as in `runs.test.ts:279-291`.

## Step-by-step tasks

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/get-node-output.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const getNodeOutputTool = defineTool({ name: "get_node_output", … })`, input
  ```ts
  z.object({
    runId: z.string().min(1).describe("The run id"),
    node: z.string().min(1).describe("A task id, or a review node: @reviewer, @tester, @fixer, @gate-fixer, @gate, @merge, @<reviewer id>"),
    lines: z.number().int().min(1).max(2000).optional().describe("How many log lines from the end (default 200)"),
  })
  ```
  Steps:
  1. workspace + run folder; `runDetail(...)`; when `detail?.state` is missing → `{ isError: true, text: `run ${runId} has no state.json` }` (a suite: `run ${runId} is a suite; get_node_output works on runs`).
  2. Known nodes: task ids in `detail.tasks` order (fall back to `Object.keys(state.tasks)`), then `@gate`, `@gate-fixer`, the reviewer nodes (enabled reviewers of `<runDir>/reviewers.json` parsed with `parseReviewers(JSON.parse(text), file)` filtered `enabled`, else `BUILTIN_REVIEWERS`; node `code` → `@reviewer`, else `@<id>`), `@fixer`, `@merge`. Unknown node → `{ isError: true, text: `unknown node ${node} in run ${runId}; nodes: ${known.join(", ")}` }`.
  3. Header: `Node <node> of run <runId> (<title>)`, title = task row title, or `validation`, `validation fixer`, the reviewer's name, `fixer`, `apply`. Then `status: <s>, attempts: <a>` (task: the `detail.tasks` row; pipeline: the cached view node, else `status: unknown (no cached view of this run)`), then `error: <e>` when the row/view node has one, then `summary: <cause> <why>` from the newest `summaries/<sanitize(node)>-<digits>.json` that parses with `cause`/`why` strings (optional, skip silently on any error). For `@merge`, add `apply: <view.summary.merge.reason>` when set.
  4. Log: pick the file per the table above; `readTailLines(file, lines ?? 200)`; append `agent log <rel path> (last N lines):` + `fenced(tail)`, or `no agent log for <node> yet` when there is none. For a task also tail the newest `<id>-validate-<n>.log` (max 50 lines) when it exists, headed `validation output <rel path>:`. Then `other logs: a, b` listing remaining matching files.
- **IMPORTS**: `readdir, readFile, stat` from `node:fs/promises`; `BUILTIN_REVIEWERS, parseReviewers, RUN_REVIEWERS_FILE` from `graph-execution/api`; `runDetail` from `../runs.js`; helpers from `./run-helpers.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: never build a file path from the raw `node` string: only from a node found in the known list, through the local `logFileName`. Matching by prefix must be exact per the table (e.g. for `@fixer` use `/^fix-r([1-9]\d*)(-v\d+)?\.log$/`, for `@gate-fixer` `/^fix-r0-v\d+\.log$/`, for reviewer `x` `new RegExp(`^${escape(x)}-r\\d+\\.log$`)`). A missing `logs/` folder is not an error.
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/get-node-output.test.ts`

### CREATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/get-artifacts.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: `export const getArtifactsTool = defineTool({ name: "get_artifacts", input: z.object({ runId: z.string().min(1).describe("The run id") }), … })`. Decided computation (from `state.json`):
  1. workspace + run folder; `runDetail(ws, runId, dataDir)`; no state → error as above. `status = detail.summary.status`, `state = detail.state`.
  2. Result commit: `git rev-parse --verify --quiet <state.integrationBranch>^{commit}`. The integration branch holds every merged task for every status: for `applied` it is what was squash-applied, for `done` it is the result, for a run still going or failed it is what is merged so far.
  3. When it resolves to `head`: `git diff --no-renames --name-status <state.startingCommit> <head> -- . :(exclude).graph-execution` and the same with `--numstat`; join by path. Status letters: `A` → `added`, `M` → `modified`, `D` → `deleted`, `T` → `type changed`; numstat `-\t-` → `binary`, else `+<added> -<deleted>`.
  4. When the branch is gone and `status === "applied"`: fall back to the workspace's uncommitted changes (what landed): `git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all -- . :(exclude).graph-execution` for paths/status (`??`/`A` → added, `D` → deleted, else modified) and `git diff --numstat HEAD -- . :(exclude).graph-execution` for counts (untracked files: `+?`). Say `(from the working tree: the result branch <b> is gone; it may include your own uncommitted changes)`.
  5. Branch gone otherwise: the line `The result branch <b> is gone; no changed files to show.` (not an error).
  6. Header line by status: `applied` → `Run <id> was applied to <targetBranch ?? "the checkout"> as uncommitted changes. Files it changed (<startingCommit 7 chars>..<b>):`; `done` → `Run <id> is done; the result is on branch <b>. Files it changed:`; anything else → `Run <id> is <status>: not finished, this is what is merged into <b> so far. Files changed:`.
  7. Table `file | status | +/-`, at most 500 rows then `… and N more files`; `No files changed.` when empty.
  8. `Report files:` — workspace-relative paths (with `/`) of `run.log`, every file under `<runDir>/reports/` (recursive), and `*.json` directly in `<runDir>/summaries/` (not `summaries/work/`), each only when it exists; sorted; `none` when empty.
- **IMPORTS**: `execa` from `execa`; `readdir` from `node:fs/promises`; `RUNS_DIR` from `graph-execution/api`; `runDetail` from `../runs.js`; helpers from `./run-helpers.js`.
- **GOTCHA**: `startingCommit` may not exist in the repo (tests write `"0".repeat(40)`): when the diff fails, report `could not diff <startingCommit>..<b> (git failed)` instead of throwing. Pass commit-ish values as separate argv items, never through a shell.
- **VALIDATE**: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools/get-artifacts.test.ts`

### UPDATE `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/index.ts`

- **IMPLEMENT**: add `getNodeOutputTool as GmTool` and `getArtifactsTool as GmTool` to `TOOLS` (after `get_run_log`).

### CREATE tests `apps/graph-manager/src/server/tools/get-node-output.test.ts` and `get-artifacts.test.ts`

Inside `describe.skipIf(process.platform === "win32")`, with `toolApp()`/`writeRun()`:
- get_node_output:
  - failed task 2 (`writeRun` default) with `logs/2.log` of 300 lines → text has `status: failed, attempts: 2` and the fenced tail with lines 101–300 (default 200); `{ lines: 3 }` → only the last 3.
  - a cached view with an error: write `<config.dataDir>/views/github~octo~hello/<runId>.json` (shape `CachedView`, see `runs.test.ts:92-98` for a minimal valid one: `{ version: 1, runId, savedAt: "x", final: true, phase: { phase: "done" }, nodes: {}, agents: {} }`; shape in `viewcache.ts:30-55`) with `nodes: { "2": { status: "failed", error: "agent exited with code 1" } }` → `error: agent exited with code 1`.
  - `@reviewer` with `logs/code-r1.log` and a newer `logs/code-r2.log` → tails `code-r2.log`, lists `code-r1.log` under other logs.
  - unknown node `9` → isError, `unknown node 9 in run <id>; nodes: 1, 2, @gate, @gate-fixer, @reviewer, @tester, @fixer, @merge`.
  - a node without log → `no agent log for 1 yet`; bad run id → `unknown run <id>`; outside workspace → workspace error.
- get_artifacts:
  - real git: base commit, then `git checkout -q -b graph/<id>`, add `src/a.ts` (3 lines), modify an existing tracked file, delete one, commit, `git checkout -q main`; `writeRun(wsDir, id, { status: "applied", startingCommit: base, integrationBranch: `graph/${id}`, targetBranch: "main" })` → rows `src/a.ts | added | +3 -0`, the modified and deleted files; header mentions `applied to main`.
  - `.graph-execution/<id>/reports/round1/code.json` and `run.log` exist → `Report files:` lists `.graph-execution/<id>/reports/round1/code.json` and `.graph-execution/<id>/run.log`.
  - status `failed` → header says `not finished, this is what is merged into graph/<id> so far`.
  - applied with the branch deleted and an uncommitted file in the workspace → the working-tree fallback lists it.
  - outside workspace / unknown run errors.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `GET /api/internal/tools` lists `get_node_output` and `get_artifacts`.
- [ ] `get_node_output` for a failed task includes `status: failed` and the tail of `logs/<task>.log`; `lines` caps it (default 200, max 2000); an unknown node returns `unknown node <node> in run <id>; nodes: …` with the valid ids.
- [ ] Review nodes (`@reviewer`, `@tester`, `@fixer`, `@gate-fixer`, `@gate`, custom `@<id>`) resolve to the log files in the table; the newest one is tailed.
- [ ] `get_artifacts` for an applied run lists the files the run changed (path, status, +/-) from `startingCommit..integrationBranch`, falls back to the working tree when the branch is gone, says "merged so far" for an unfinished run, and lists the run's report files as workspace-relative paths.
- [ ] Both tools return `this terminal is not inside a graph-manager workspace` outside a workspace and `unknown run <id>` for a bad or foreign run id.
- [ ] Tests pass: `cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools`

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
cd apps/graph-manager && npx vitest run src/server/tools
```
